newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open weaker, depressed by Dow decline.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open weaker, depressed by Dow decline.

text.p: British shares opened lower on Thursday as a sharp drop on Wall Street weighed on the market and concerns about the Dow's health kept investors edgy.
Dealers said they expected a day of thin, jittery trade, dominated by nervousness ahead of Friday's U.S. non-farm payrolls data. "No-one wants to be heroic ahead of the data," one said.
The FTSE 100 index of blue-chip shares opened 23.3 points weaker at 4,213.3 and was down 17.9 points at 4,218.7 by 0800 GMT. The FTSE 250 index of mid-cap stocks was 14.7 points lower at 4,492.8.
